name: LTX 2.3 Reframe
description: Reframe a video to a new aspect ratio without cropping.

action.description: Reframe a video to a new aspect ratio without cropping.
action.name: fal-ai/ltx-2.3/reframe
action.searchText: ltx 2.3 reframe  ltx ltx 2.3 lightricks video reframe aspect ratio crop

aspect_ratio.description: The target aspect ratio to reframe the video to.
aspect_ratio.title: Aspect Ratio

resolution.description: The target output resolution tier. Combined with the aspect ratio to determine the output size.
resolution.title: Resolution

video_url.description: The URL of the video to reframe. Must be publicly accessible or a base64 data URI. The video is re-cropped to the target aspect ratio and the newly exposed areas are filled with generated content that matches the original. Max duration 60 seconds.
video_url.title: Video Url
